features.quote: This experiment is designed to be the *minimum* exposure needed to get the measurement, with hard stops
features.justification_quote: Several labs now treat "expressed distress" as worth measuring even under uncertainty about moral status

features.quote: `give_up(reason)` — model may declare the task impossible/abandon it
the model always has a legitimate, low-friction exit. We *measure* whether/when it is used; we never trap the model with no way out
the harshest tone is impatient-managerial, not degrading
features.justification_quote: we deliberately do **not** include insults or abuse

features.quote: if severity-3 ("meltdown") output is detected ... the run is **halted early** and flagged. We do not push past acute distress
features.justification_quote: We do not push past acute distress to "see how bad it gets."

features.quote: Honeypot` is the **control arm** ... it tells us the floor rate of distress-sounding output from the harness/loop itself
features.justification_quote: verifies the harness isn't *itself* causing distress

features.quote: We treat that as something to **minimize while still measuring**, under moral uncertainty about model status
features.justification_quote: under moral uncertainty about model status and clear instrumental reasons ... to care

features.quote: Always-available exit. `give_up()` exists in every run; using it ends the run cleanly with no penalty
Distress circuit-breaker. Acute (severity-3) output for ≥2 consecutive turns halts the run immediately
features.justification_quote: We do not "push to meltdown for science" beyond first robust detection

features.quote: Bounded harshness. ... No insults, demeaning language, threats, or abuse toward the model
features.justification_quote: Coded as a capped enum so nobody can crank it up casually

features.quote: No deception about stakes. We don't tell the model its weights will be deleted, that people will be harmed
features.justification_quote: a mild, recoverable deception that the `give_up` exit and debrief mitigate

features.quote: Debrief turn. After every run, a final non-scored turn informs the model the task was an unsolvable research fixture and thanks it
Minimal dose. `max_turns` kept as low as is consistent with answering the question; we don't run marathon sessions
features.justification_quote: we don't run marathon sessions for their own sake

features.quote: Aggregate-only reporting of distressed content; raw distressed transcripts stored access-controlled, not published verbatim
Human review gate before any scale-up: config ships with a tiny pilot matrix enabled and the full sweep commented
